target_host.accelerators: CPU-only; no GPU, NPU, or hosted inference

protocol.selection_rule: This is a comparative selection gate, not the superseded 30-by-6 release-performance matrix. Each observed sample must meet every timing and throughput ceiling.

warm_session_reset.rule: A stalled /clear is terminated and replaced sequentially. The replacement is primed and successfully cleared before the next warm sample; every replacement is recorded in the raw sample.

protocol.network: disabled after verified local artifact staging; llama-cli receives --offline and no listener, server, tool, or provider flag

acceptance.swap: Record before/after and per-sample movement as an operational diagnostic only. It neither invalidates a run nor changes an acceptance result.
acceptance.hard_rejection: A candidate that exceeds an artifact, RSS, TTFT, completion, or throughput ceiling in any observed selection sample is rejected regardless of answer style or later quality evidence.

evidence.workload_contract: A benchmark run requires a complete M6-02 candidate-neutral workload. It never calls ordinary search, cross-locale retrieval, external sources, or a web provider.
evidence.answer_prompt: The runner serializes only the prepared same-locale context_jsonl, dialogue turns, and question as one canonical stdin JSON line. It uses the GGUF's Jinja template, non-thinking mode, and a 96-token maximum.
evidence.retrieval_artifacts: A run records the checksum-verified E5-base model directory and complete active exact-generation root used to prepare its workload. Their disk footprint is included with the direct chat runtime/model footprint.

progress.content: real candidate/locale/state/scenario, completed comparative samples, lifecycle phase, verified artifact state, and terminal result; no synthetic progress or ETA

boundaries.output: Raw records, prompts, model output, and reports remain ignored under documentation/.cache/bpm093-m6-03/.
